title: The Foragers of Thorn Bottom
introduction: The Thorn Bottom foraging club keeps meticulous records, chiefly so that blame can be apportioned later. There are 6 foragers. Each went out on a different day, listed from earlier to later: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday. The foragers are Ramiro, Tobias, Ottokar, Solomon, Eilish and Guinevere. Each made a different find from this list: a cauliflower fungus, a chicken of the woods, a saffron milk cap, a hen of the woods, a horn of plenty, a penny bun. Each searched a different wood from this list: Nettlebed, the Old Deer Park, Hangman's Copse, the Larches, Scrag End, Bell Wood. Each carried a different basket from this list: a wooden box, a string bag, a wicker trug, an upturned hat, a willow creel, a tin pail. Within each category every member belongs to a different forager, so each day, name, find, wood and basket is used exactly once.
clues: The forager who finds a cauliflower fungus and Saturday are exactly three days apart in day order.

The forager who finds a saffron milk cap and Saturday are exactly two days apart in day order, and the forager who finds a saffron milk cap and the forager who searches Scrag End are exactly one day apart in day order.
Solomon and Monday are exactly one day apart in day order.
If Guinevere and Wednesday are exactly one day apart in day order, then the forager who carries an upturned hat and Eilish are exactly one day apart in day order.
The forager who searches the Larches falls somewhere between Friday and Tobias in day order, matching neither of them.
Counting Monday as the first day, Friday and the forager who searches Nettlebed are either both at odd-numbered days or both at even-numbered days.
The forager who carries a wicker trug and the forager who finds a horn of plenty are exactly one day apart in day order.
Ottokar and the forager who searches the Old Deer Park are exactly one day apart in day order, and the forager who searches the Old Deer Park is earlier than the forager who carries a willow creel.
If the forager who carries a wicker trug searches Hangman's Copse, then the forager who searches Scrag End is earlier than the forager who carries a string bag in day order.
If Ottokar does not search Nettlebed, then Ramiro searches Nettlebed.
The forager who carries a string bag does not search Bell Wood, but the forager who carries a string bag and Eilish are exactly one day apart in day order.

The forager who finds a penny bun is exactly one day earlier than the forager who searches Bell Wood, with no day in between. Eilish and the forager who searches Bell Wood are exactly one day apart in day order.

At least one of these is true, and possibly both: Eilish and the forager who searches Scrag End are exactly one day apart in day order; Guinevere is earlier than the forager who carries a tin pail in day order.
The forager who finds a chicken of the woods is earlier than Ottokar in day order.
